name: Ann Marie Genello
livingEvidence: Named as a surviving sister ('Ann Marie Genello') of John T. Petriello Sr. in his March 2025 obituary (site facts); probably also the 'cousin Ann Marie' surviving John Jr. in Feb 2024. Born c.1933-34 (1940/1950 censuses).
